# `aitbc economics model`

Run an economic model of the configured type.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc economics model [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--type` | text | `cost-optimization` | no | Model type |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc economics model
```
